## Assignment Options

Use the core packet for a focused homework assignment, or open the Builder to select the longer context-rich project version.

::: {.callout-note}
## Recommended Starting Point

- **Core homework:** FBD, design load, brace reactions, boom check, brace/connection check, engineering decision.
- **Project version:** adds materials, geometry, failure-mode, and acceptance-criteria prompts before the calculation sequence.
- **Best workflow:** open the Builder, choose a variant, adjust values, then export student and instructor packets.
:::

## Default Given Data

| Symbol | Quantity | Default value |
|---|---|---:|
| $L$ | Boom length | 2.4 m |
| $L_b$ | Brace attachment distance | 1.6 m |
| $\theta$ | Brace angle | 35 deg |
| $M$ | Battery pack mass | 450 kg |
| $H$ | Horizontal service load | 500 N |
| $e_H$ | Horizontal-load vertical offset | 0.3 m |
| $\gamma_d$ | Dynamic load factor | 1.25 |
| $S$ | Boom section modulus | 85,000 mm^3 |
| $I$ | Boom second moment of area | 8,500,000 mm^4 |
| $A_b$ | Brace area | 650 mm^2 |
| $d_p$ | Brace pin diameter | 20 mm |
| $t$ | Connection plate thickness | 12 mm |
| $\sigma_y$ | Steel yield strength | 250 MPa |
